description: Split a long document (e.g. an annual report) into its logical sections via one LLM call per document, then optionally suggest a field schema per section type.

inputs.description: Input DataFrame with a column of PDF file paths or PDF bytes

outputs.description: One row per detected section: passthrough columns + section_type, page_start, page_end, section_text (+ suggested_schema_json when suggest_schema is true)

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', or None for unpartitioned

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter upstream DataFrame to the current date partition key.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter upstream DataFrame to the current static partition dimension (e.g. 'customer_id').

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run (the upstream DataFrame is filtered once per partition key in the range and the matching rows are combined). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave unset for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For backfill_policy='multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave unset for Dagster's default (1 partition per run).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset, e.g. {'domain': 'finance', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog, e.g. ['snowflake', 'python']. Auto-inferred from component name if not set.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage mapping: output column name → list of upstream column names it was derived from, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first 5 rows as a markdown table). Used by builder UIs to render asset shape without warehouse access.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when `include_preview_metadata` is True. For long DataFrames (>10x preview_rows), a random sample is used so the preview reflects the data distribution; otherwise head() is used.

column.label: Column
column.description: Column containing PDF file paths or PDF bytes to split into sections

passthrough_columns.label: Passthrough Columns
passthrough_columns.description: Upstream columns to carry onto every output section row. Defaults to every upstream column except `column`.

section_types.label: Section Types
section_types.description: The section-type taxonomy the model is asked to classify pages into. Defaults to a financial-report shape (cover, table_of_contents, md_a, balance_sheet, income_statement, cash_flow_statement, notes, auditor_report, other) -- replace with your own fully custom list for a different document domain. Classification is model-dependent, not deterministic.

suggest_schema.label: Suggest Schema
suggest_schema.description: For each unique section_type actually produced (deduped across the whole run, not per row), make one additional LLM call suggesting a field schema worth extracting from sections of that type. Adds a `suggested_schema_json` column. Set False to skip schema suggestion entirely.

schema_model.label: Schema Model
schema_model.description: LiteLLM model string for the schema-suggestion call. Defaults to `classification_model` when unset.

max_schema_fields.label: Max Schema Fields
max_schema_fields.description: Maximum number of {field, description} entries requested per section_type's suggested schema.

classification_model.label: Classification Model
classification_model.description: LiteLLM model string for the per-document page-classification call. A cheap model is a reasonable default for this kind of coarse page-level classification; it is not required to be any specific model.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the LLM provider API key.

llm_max_retries.label: Llm Max Retries
llm_max_retries.description: Max retries forwarded to litellm's num_retries for both the classification and schema-suggestion calls.

max_content_chars.label: Max Content Chars
max_content_chars.description: Maximum characters of assembled page text (classification call) or section text (schema-suggestion call) sent to the model. A document whose combined page text exceeds this is truncated.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on failure. Defines a RetryPolicy when set.

name: Document Section Splitter
